title: Production backend/schema incompatibility
evidence: Fly logs + read-only SQL: four enabled rsvp rows; deployed 954e995f1 recognizes only public-listable and ticket-purchase. Both machines restarting.
rootCause: Older executable rejects capabilities already in the shared database.
proposedChange: Coordinate recovery with the active release operator; verify compatible artifact, migrations, preserved flags and each machine.
dependencies: release operator completes/hands over current deployment
acceptanceCriteria: Both machines stable; /health JSON status and db ok; /version exact verified SHA; essential public and authorized synthetic journeys pass.
verificationMethod: Fly machine status, immutable digest, SQL preflight, endpoint probes and observation window.
releaseStatus: blocked: another production deployment is active; no production mutations by this task

title: Startup readiness falsely returns HTTP 200
evidence: TDF.App.Boot bootApp uses status200; live /health returned 200 with status/db starting.
userImpact: Load balancer may route people to an app that cannot serve their tasks.
rootCause: Health status represents listening rather than readiness.
proposedChange: Serve 503 with Retry-After until initialization atomically swaps in mkApp.
acceptanceCriteria: Startup /health and protected paths return 503; initialized health still returns 200/ok; no schema or gate changes.
verificationMethod: Two executable Hspec tests; full CI/build and staging still required.

title: Startup recovery message is not valid Spanish UTF-8
surface: Startup recovery message is not valid Spanish UTF-8
evidence: Live message contained replacement character; overloaded ByteString literal includes accented á.
userImpact: Recovery message is corrupted for users and JSON consumers.
rootCause: Non-ASCII JSON encoded through a ByteString string literal.
proposedChange: Use Aeson encoding and explicit UTF-8 content type.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict JSON decoding returns exact Spanish message; Retry-After and no-store present.
verificationMethod: Hspec decodes actual WAI response body.

title: Browser storage denial can prevent public app startup
surface: Browser storage denial can prevent public app startup
evidence: i18n/index.ts reads localStorage before module initialization; AppThemeProvider read/write outside try; SessionContext evaluates storage getter before its inner catch. Runtime regression added before fixes. Follow-up provider integration reproduced two further crashes with actual nonempty locale/currency catalog data. Original browser fixture had empty catalog data and missed this path.
userImpact: Visitor cannot reach login or discovery when browser storage is restricted.
rootCause: Optional preferences/session cache treated as required boot dependencies.
proposedChange: Keep preferences in memory when storage unavailable; protect getter/read/write boundaries without fabricating a session.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous login renders and theme toggle retains input under denied operations/getters; no uncaught errors; no unauthorized session created.
verificationMethod: Playwright Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, desktop/tablet/phone and axe; exact baseline/final logs.
releaseStatus: Local storage follow-up fixed; provider integration 4/4 and realistic catalog browser cases 10/10 across five profiles. New exact-head CI still required.

title: Recovery link action returns to login without opening recovery or retaining the destination
evidence: Both incomplete-link buttons target /login, discarding a validated redirect. Source inspection and new bilingual Playwright journey assert the replacement behavior.
userImpact: A user requesting a replacement link must rediscover recovery and loses the original task destination.
rootCause: Both CTAs share a literal login path; no recovery query entry.
proposedChange: Preserve validated internal redirects and open the recovery dialog via recover=1; remove this flag on close.
acceptanceCriteria: Replacement link opens recovery directly; valid destination survives; unsafe targets remain rejected by existing routing validation; closing returns to usable login; failed request retains email with actionable feedback.
verificationMethod: PW-PER-LOCALE ES/EN across five browser/device profiles and existing loginRouting tests.
releaseStatus: Implemented; eight profiles/cases passed after contrast fix, two WebKit close checks initially intermittent; isolated WebKit rerun passed; final production bundle verification pending.

title: Password guidance lacks contrast on dark dialog backgrounds
surface: LoginPage signup helper and ResetPasswordPage helper
evidence: Axe tablet ES and EN: #475569 over #12121a, contrast 2.45:1 at 12px; before screenshot evidence/signup-contrast-before.png.
userImpact: Password requirements become difficult to read, increasing validation mistakes.
rootCause: A dark text override assumes a white input also supplies the helper background; helper is outside the white input.
proposedChange: Use the theme text.secondary color for helper text; keep password policy complete and bilingual.
acceptanceCriteria: Helper text meets 4.5:1 in light/dark themes across desktop/tablet/phone and selected browsers; no weakened axe checks.
verificationMethod: Axe plus screenshot inspection; include signup with intent and long ES/EN policy copy.
releaseStatus: Implemented; previously failing tablet cases pass; final full verification pending.
